title: Robata Shrimp Wrap
description: A flavorful and spicy wrap filled with grilled shrimp, zesty slaw, and served with a side of soy sauce.
instructions: Heat a grill or grill pan over medium-high heat.
Season the shrimp with salt and pepper.
Grill the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Meanwhile, warm the tortilla by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spread the zesty dressing on the tortilla, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top the dressing with a few pieces of grilled shrimp, some coleslaw, and a sprinkle of kapi, if using.
Drizzle the robata sauce over the top and garnish with chopped green onions.
